system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
No streaming with Sonos possible, are you aware?

PREDICTED INTENT: playback_error

PRECEDENTS:

[1044331] (similarity 0.65, intent playback_error)
  past customer: why is airplay free and Sonos play not?
  spotify replied: Hey Andy! We've more got info on this at <link> Any other questions, just give us a shout

[2041147] (similarity 0.65, intent playback_error)
  past customer: When will you allow premium users to play one stream on multiple devices via "Groups". Same as Sonos. PLEASE!!! 🙏🏻
  spotify replied: Hey Adrian! We're afraid this isn't currently possible. To help make it happen, add your support for the idea at <link>

[2626770] (similarity 0.59, intent playback_error)
  past customer: Been trying tech support all day with no luck. Sonos inoperable. Still controls volume but no access to any stations or apps.
  spotify replied: Hey Michael! What device and Spotify version are you using to connect to your Sonos? We'll see what we can suggest

[2175358] (similarity 0.59, intent playback_error)
  past customer: Just curious-why can't I play Podcasts on my Pixel 2 through my Sonos?
  spotify replied: Hi Daniel, help's here! Can you let us know your phone's Android and Spotify versions? We'll see what we can suggest

[2293038] (similarity 0.57, intent playback_error)
  past customer: Tonight I'm unable to browse Spotify through Sonos. Any server malfunction tonight?
  spotify replied: Hey! The cavalry's here. Can you fire over the device's make/model, operating system, and the Spotify version you're using?

Draft the reply as JSON.
